messages:
jamie: deploy-bot: starting rollout v3.2.0 canary 10% in change window 07:00-08:00 UTC. preflight checks running
nina: watching p95 + error-rate for embed routes
deploy-bot: canary check -> embeds p95 ok, 5xx rate 1.4% (trigger soft threshold 0.8%) sending notice to #eng-oncall
oncall-bot: NOTICE: embeds (us-east) 5xx 1.4% at 07:06. Pager suppressed. dash: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/embeds-us-east
ash: ack @oncall. correlating: backend vector-store 429s spiked at 07:04; autoscaler shows no immediate scale event
jamie: options: pause ramp, quick pin us-east to previous image, or rollback. prefer pause + pin if it worsens
nina: running smoke: `curl -s https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embed -d '{"text":"x"}' | jq .status` -> a few 500s from vector-store
jamie: executing `/deploy hold 5187654321` to freeze ramp
deploy-bot: ramp paused at 10%. request manual ack from oncall
ash: acked. applying mitigation: reduce canary concurrency flag, temp bump HPA min replicas
nina: after mitigation 2m, 5xx down to 0.6% and p95 back within 40ms. trending stable
jamie: resuming gradual ramp at 07:12 `/deploy resume 5187654321` -> target 25%
deploy-bot: ramp resumed. cleared notice at 07:13
ash: post-action: open ticket INF-402 to tune vector-store rate limits and add client backpressure. no rollback needed
nina: adding a short note to release notes: "10% hold due to transient vector-store throttling in us-east; mitigated by concurrency + HPA tweaks"
jamie: thanks team — monitoring until full ramp complete
